subject: Regional hosting verification & private network evidence
messages:
From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acme-corp.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: InfraOps <infraops@acme-corp.com>, security@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-07-19T09:14:00-07:00
Subject: Initial ask: Hosting geolocation and private deploy controls

Hi Olga / Markus,

Thanks for the demo last week. Our security & infra teams are documenting hosting boundaries as part of an upcoming procurement review. We need a short written confirmation of the following before next Friday (23 July):

- Primary region(s) where customer data (tokens, request logs, and model KV cache) can be hosted for a dedicated/private deployment; specifically we need EU hosting confirmation (data at rest and processing).
- Whether Redwood Private (VPC) supports customer-managed peering or AWS PrivateLink equivalents for dedicated instances.
- Any controls around KMS/CMK usage and region-bound key storage.

If you can attach a network diagram and a SOC 2 snapshot (latest), that would help accelerate our security sign-off.

Appreciate a brief reply — one paragraph per bullet is fine.

Best,
Liam
Liam O'Neill
Head of InfraOps, Acme Corp

---
Attachment: none

From: olga_petrov@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acme-corp.com>
Cc: markus_klein@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-20T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: Hosting geolocation and private deploy controls

Liam — thanks for the clear list. Quick answers and we can follow up with a short evidence bundle: 

- Regions: For Redwood Private deployments you can choose the hosting region. For EU-only residency we run customer-managed control plane components in eu-west-1 (AWS) or on-prem. Data at rest (blob store + KV cache snapshots) and inference processing for the tenant stay in the pinned region for the dedicated/private configuration. We will attach a network_diagram showing the control/data plane separation.

- Private connectivity: Redwood Private supports both VPC peering and AWS PrivateLink depending on customer preference. For Dedicated we also offer an option to colocate GPU pools and expose a private endpoint. Peering is customer-initiated; we provide the required IP ranges and routing guide. Attached is a short stub (vpc-connection-stub.txt) with the typical steps.

- KMS: Customer-managed CMKs are supported; keys can be provisioned in the customer-owned AWS account (EU region) and referenced through our KMS proxy. We do not replicate CMKs outside the pinned region.

I've attached an internal network diagram and a SOC2 snapshot for your team to review. If your security team needs an attestation letter on regional residency, we can route that through our compliance team — let me know and I’ll loop them in.

Thanks,
Olga Petrov
Senior Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
olga_petrov@redwood.ai

Attachments:
- network-diagram.pdf (high-level control/data plane)
- vpc-connection-stub.txt (peering/privatelink checklist)
- SOC2-snapshot-2026.pdf (redacted snapshot)

From: markus_klein@redwood.ai
To: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acme-corp.com>, olga_petrov@redwood.ai
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-07-21T08:33:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: Hosting geolocation and private deploy controls

Quick operational clarifications from our side so your infra/security reviewers have what they need: 

- Audit logging: tenant-level audit logs for Redwood Private are writable to a customer-managed S3 bucket in the pinned region; retention policies are configured by the customer.
- Egress/ingress controls: egress CIDR can be restricted and VPC endpoints only accept traffic from approved subnets.
- Fallback policy: if a customer requests cross-region failover we keep a strict replica policy and obtain signed consent for cross-region KV snapshot replication. Default is no cross-region replication.

If you want, we can produce a 1-page attestation confirming "No customer data leaves the pinned EU region unless explicitly configured and approved" with a compliance contact signature. I'll draft that and send by EOD if you confirm.

-Markus
Markus Klein
Head of Product Operations, Redwood Inference
markus_klein@redwood.ai

Attachment: none

From: Liam O'Neill <liam.oneill@acme-corp.com>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.ai, markus_klein@redwood.ai
Cc: InfraOps <infraops@acme-corp.com>, security@acme-corp.com
Date: 2026-07-22T15:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Initial ask: Hosting geolocation and private deploy controls

Thanks, Olga and Markus — that's exactly what we needed. A few quick follow-ups from our security reviewer: 

1) Please proceed with the 1-page attestation language and include the compliance contact. We need it on letterhead.
2) Can you confirm the default behavior for KV cache snapshot encryption at rest (AES-256 with customer CMK or service-managed?) — we prefer customer CMK.
3) For peering: can you share a sample BGP/VPN diagram if you support on-prem VPN fallback? The network_diagram.pdf covers the control/data plane well but they want the VPN fallthrough scenario too.

If you can get (1) and (2) to us by Friday morning EU time, we can close the procurement DAL and move to contract.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Best,
Liam
